dedupe_keys.name: influent parameter concentrations mass loading values and influent flow values for evaluating operations during dry weather flows at california wastewater treatment facilities

description: Influent Parameter Concentrations, Mass Loading Values, and Influent Flow Values for Evaluating Operations During Dry Weather Flows at California Wastewater Treatment Facilities is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Keene, Dakota (deposited on HydroShare). Wastewater treatment facilities must manage water quality during both average flow and extreme events, including wet and dry weather periods. Constituent concentrations can increase during dry weather flow events, since facilities experience reduced incidental infiltration and influent flows may be lower as a result. Coverage: California, United States. The resource was created 2022-05-17 and last updated 2022-05-17; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
